question: Which Ensembl version does the current Human Protein Atlas release build on?

turns.text:
According to the Human Protein Atlas homepage (https://www.proteinatlas.org/), the current release is **version 25.1**.

According to the Human Protein Atlas Release History page (https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/releases), this release builds on **Ensembl version 109**.
